long.title: How We Install a Heated Tile Floor, and What It Really Costs
alternates: Heated Bathroom Floors: How They Go In and What They Cost
Is a Heated Bathroom Floor Worth It? Full Install Walkthrough
long.description:
Thinking about a heated floor in your bathroom? In this one I walk you through exactly how we put one in on the master bath at the East Bench House.

You'll see the Schluter mat that goes down over the whole floor, how the heating wire snaps in, and why we only run it where people actually stand: in front of the toilet, the vanity, and where you step out of the tub. I'll also show you the one test you have to do before any tile goes down, so you don't find a break in the wire after the floor is finished.

Then we fire it up on the programmable thermostat, and stick around to the end to hear what a floor like this really costs.
